scope: Engineering changes and build verification, excluding poll/settle sweeps and audio. Commit times are recording times, not isolated execution durations. Not every checkpoint has a separate performance measurement.

checkpoints.title: Smaller Python previews
checkpoints.detail: Return 640 px previews; request full detail only when needed.

checkpoints.title: Native Rust ingestion
checkpoints.detail: Implement ONVIF and persistent RTSP with a latest-frame buffer.

checkpoints.title: Complete the Rust tool path
checkpoints.detail: Port MCP, visual tracking, native JPEG assembly and background pose polling.

checkpoints.title: Keep I/O nonblocking
checkpoints.detail: Move codec work onto blocking workers; isolate short-lived detail streams.

checkpoints.title: Connect only on demand
checkpoints.detail: Lazily initialize camera connections and retire the Python runtime.

checkpoints.title: Instrument the whole path
checkpoints.detail: Trace network, queueing, video, image processing and MCP output.

checkpoints.title: Recover frames locally
checkpoints.detail: Drop malformed JPEG frames without restarting the RTSP session.

checkpoints.title: Reuse encoding state
checkpoints.detail: Cache the TurboJPEG compressor and skip unnecessary thumbnailing.

checkpoints.title: SIMD image processing
checkpoints.detail: Use fast_image_resize with reusable state for images that need resizing.

checkpoints.title: Verify accelerated builds
checkpoints.detail: Rebuild cached OpenH264 with NASM; verify assembly symbols in the release archive.
